# readme-toc-gen

> Generate a GitHub-style table of contents for markdown, with idempotent marker-based insertion and dry-run diffs.

This library parses ATX (`#`) headings out of markdown text — correctly skipping fenced code blocks
so fake headings inside ```` ``` ```` fences never leak into the TOC — computes GitHub-compatible
slugs (with `-1`, `-2` dedup for repeated heading text), and renders a bullet or numbered TOC. It can
insert or replace that TOC between `<!-- toc -->` / `<!-- tocstop -->` markers idempotently: running
it twice on its own output produces no further diff. A small line-based diff helper supports
dry-run previews before writing anything to disk.

## API

- `parseHeadings(markdown: string): Heading[]`
- `githubSlug(text: string, seen?: Map<string, number>): string`
- `generateToc(markdown: string, options?: GenerateOptions): string`
- `insertToc(markdown: string, options?: InsertOptions): string`
- `diffToc(original: string, updated: string): DiffLine[]`
- `formatDiff(diff: DiffLine[]): string`
- Types: `Heading`, `GenerateOptions`, `InsertOptions`, `DiffLine`

## Install

```
npm install readme-toc-gen
```

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
